verdicts.reason: Both use the same competent stacked layout: label, headline, body and CTA on a shared left edge, with the bottle and circle at the bottom. In both, the bottle cap sits almost against the Shop Sale button, and the bottle-plus-circle cluster is crowded into the lower-left with only a thin margin at the bottom. A starts its text lower (about 70px top margin against about 38px at the bottom), so the top is unbalanced and the gap between the CTA and the bottle cap is only about 20px. B's top margin (about 30px) is close to its side margins, and it leaves more space between the text lines and above the bottle, so it is very slightly more even.
